definitions.gloss: dispatch; deployment; mobilization (of emergency services or police)
definitions.explanation: The action of police, fire, ambulance, or military personnel being sent out to a scene. Used with する as a verb. Almost exclusively associated with organized response units, not ordinary travel.

examples.japanese: {消防車|しょうぼうしゃ}が{出動|しゅつどう}した。
パトカーが{現場|げんば}に{出動|しゅつどう}した。
examples.english: A patrol car was deployed to the scene.

examples.japanese: {昨年度|さくねんど}の{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}{出動件数|しゅつどうけんすう}は{過去最高|かこさいこう}を{記録|きろく}した。
examples.english: The number of ambulance dispatches last fiscal year hit an all-time high.

notes:
Compound of {出|しゅつ} (go out) + {動|どう} (move, act). Used with する to form a suru-verb. The subject is typically the responding vehicle or unit ({救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}が{出動|しゅつどう}する), not the individual responder.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現場|げんば}に{出動|しゅつどう}する: to be deployed to the scene
- {出動|しゅつどう}{要請|ようせい}: a request for dispatch
- {出動件数|しゅつどうけんすう}: number of dispatches (statistic)
- {緊急|きんきゅう}{出動|しゅつどう}: emergency dispatch

TYPICAL SUBJECTS:
- {救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ} (ambulance), {消防車|しょうぼうしゃ} (fire truck), パトカー (patrol car), {自衛隊|じえいたい} (Self-Defense Forces)
